name: replace-words
description:
The phrase with whole words and phrases replaced by pairs (what to find → its replacement).

Case and ё do not count. Longer phrases go first: «стиральная машинка» → «стиральная машина» before «машинка» → «машина». Punctuation at the edges of the found words stays around the replacement («диван,» → «софа,»); an empty replacement deletes the words with that punctuation («купить диван, недорого» → «купить недорого»).

case: "new" — the replacement as given; "keep" — in the case of the first word it replaces (lower, capitalised, upper; a word of mixed case keeps the replacement as given).

Example: semkit read --text "купить диван, недорого" replace-words pairs.csv write -
-> купить софа, недорого

pairs: a file of two columns, what to find and its replacement; the first row is the header, the file is read like `read` does.

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

options.name: --pairs
options.description: a file of two columns, what to find and its replacement; the first row is the header, the file is read like `read` does.

options.name: --case
options.description: "new" — the replacement as given; "keep" — in the case of the first word it replaces (lower, capitalised, upper; a word of mixed case keeps the replacement as given).

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.

arguments.name: PAIRS
arguments.description: a file of two columns, what to find and its replacement; the first row is the header, the file is read like `read` does. The same as --pairs PAIRS.
